node.statement: By lem-maincb-reset-constant-ledger, W is the single ledger built from the same universal witnesses used by all producer and reset lemmas. Applying lem-maincb-structural-domain-ledger to 0 <= epsilon <= W.epsilon_MAIN gives epsilon <= W.e_env and epsilon <= W.e_s2/W.K2, and gives W.L*epsilon <= W.K_call*epsilon <= W.r_reset and W.K_call*epsilon <= e_sim.
